name_reason: Conforms to fd2_<domain>_<descriptor>; 'execute_special_attack_skill' accurately describes executing a character special attack technique (必殺技 / sword-skill cinematic for spell ids 0x18,0x1C,0x1D,0x1E). No Ghidra address residue in the name.
purpose: Execute a character-specific special attack technique (必殺技): a weapon-tied cinematic attack with bigger-than-normal damage and a full character-vs-character FIGANI animation overlay, for spell ids 0x18 (淒煌斬), 0x1C (熾炎刀, multi-hit), 0x1D (音速刃), and 0x1E default fallback.
logic_summary: Frees the large game-state/portrait/snapshot caches to reclaim heap, picks the per-spell damage multiplier {0x18:15,0x1C:20,0x1D:12,else:18}, computes raw_damage = (int16)caster.ap*multiplier/10. Reads the caster tile attribute, resolves AoE terrain, and loads BG/TAI cinematic layers (3 BG parallax sub-layers into data_fd2_battle_special_cinematic_bg_layers) plus caster and per-target FIGANI sheets; builds the FIGANI SFX bank. Plays palette fade-to-black, the caster intro-zoom, and the figani intro loop. Per target: animates the bg-zoom transition (skipped for 0x1C), snapshots HP, applies damage via fd2_apply_damage_and_award_xp (clamped to current HP, then restored), and drives the per-frame FIGANI loop (frame range [caster_figani_b[+2]..caster_figani_b[+0])). Each frame fires an optional per-frame SFX (entry +5) and an optional hit marker (entry +4==1) that progressively re-applies HP = original_HP - hit_count*applied_dmg/max_hits (max_hits=8 for 0x1C else 1) and flashes the target sprite; each sub-frame (entry +6 count) composites work buffers with a shake X-offset from data_fd2_battle_special_attack_shake_x_offset_table[fade_steps] (fade_steps ramps 5->0) and commits to the mode-13h framebuffer. Cleanup frees all loaded resources (pBg_layer_saved is freed twice, a vendor double-free preserved verbatim), stops/free the SFX bank, reallocates the large game-state buffer, reloads the battle-scene snapshot from FDSHAP.DAT, restores the portrait cache, fades out/clears/recomposites/fades in.
signature: void __cdecl fd2_execute_special_attack_skill(uint32 caster_idx, uint32 spell_id, int n_targets, uint8 *target_idx_buf)

params.name: caster_idx
params.semantics: runtime_char_array index of the caster; used to read caster.ap/portrait_id and to flash/intro/animate the caster sprite.
params.reason: Accurately names the caster index; no address residue.

params.name: spell_id
params.semantics: Special-attack spell id (0x18, 0x1C, 0x1D, or default 0x1E); selects the damage multiplier, the multi-hit (0x1C) path, max_hits, and which BG vs TAI layer is blitted.
params.reason: Accurate; matches caller dispatch (spell_id==0x18 or in [0x1C..0x1F]).

params.name: n_targets
params.semantics: Number of targets; bounds the per-target attack loop, the figani-load loop, and the cleanup free loop.
params.reason: Accurate target-count name; no address residue.

params.name: target_idx_buf
params.semantics: Pointer to the byte array of target runtime_char indices; indexed target_idx_buf[i] for per-target HP read/write, damage, sprite flash, and terrain resolution.
params.reason: Accurate; correctly identified as the target-id buffer (the caller's 4th arg, which Ghidra auto-named 'caster_idx' at the caller side -- here the src param name is already correct).

returns.semantics: No return value; side effects are the on-screen cinematic, progressive HP changes on the targeted runtime_char entries, and reallocation/reload of the large game-state buffer and battle-scene snapshot.
